ticket: Ticket 17 — Jesse Runtime Integration & Edge Validation

experiment.phase_a: 4 per-file Jesse agents called per candidate bar in NYXEngine._build_fractal_report_features. 21 rep_* features (enriched from Ticket 13's 13) merged alongside rule_* proxies + Ticket 09 liquidity-hunter features.

delta_t13_to_t17.note: Ticket 16 calibration objectively improved agent quality (T13→T17)

delta_baseline_to_t17.note: 21 extra rep_* features still degrade OOS edge vs 173-feature baseline

decision_rationale: Per ticket decision rules: Sharpe ↓ (-12.3%) + drawdown ↑ (+54%) = REJECT.
Calibration (T16) DID improve the signal: T13 Sharpe 8.04 → T17 Sharpe 8.73 (+8.6%). The direction is positive. But absolute delta from baseline (9.96) is still -12.3%.

Root cause hypothesis: the per-file Jesse agents are rule-based (Context SMA fallback, Regime ADX heuristic, Setup liquidity-hunter heuristic blend, Entry momentum threshold). They produce ~0.0/0.5/1.0 binary-ish rep_* values on each bar. The GBM trained on 173 technical features already captures the same information (via rule_context/rule_regime/rule_setup proxies + ATR/EMA/RSI/ADX features). The rep_* features are REDUNDANT — they add noise without adding new orthogonal signal.

The per-file agents' .report() values are NOT ML-probability-based — they're heuristic scores (0.0 or 1.0 for passed, 0.5 for score default). A future experiment could swap to the mono-file ML-based JesseContextAgent/etc. (RandomForest trained on BTC) whose .report() would emit calibrated probabilities. That would test whether ML-derived probabilities (vs heuristic scores) add genuine orthogonal signal to the 173-feature GBM.
Artefact REVERTED to Ticket 11 baseline (Sharpe 9.96 preserved). Wiring KEPT committed for future experiments.
next_step_suggestions: HYBRID: analyze GBM feature_importances_ from the Ticket 17 model to see if ANY rep_* feature had non-zero importance. If yes, keep only those; if no, the signal is genuinely absent.
Swap to mono-file ML-based Jesse*Agent (RandomForest, trained on BTC pre-training slice). Their .report() would emit calibrated ML probabilities instead of heuristic 0/1/0.5 values.

Structural-only: keep Jesse agents for MetaGBM disagr/quality_bucket/risk_hint enrichment (Ticket 06/07 path) without feeding their scores into the GBM features. The agents remain an OBSERVABILITY layer, not a signal layer.
